sources.name: Sentiment140
sources.citation: Go, Bhayani & Huang (2009), Twitter Sentiment Classification using Distant Supervision

sources.name: GoEmotions (raw)
sources.citation: Demszky et al. (2020), GoEmotions: A Dataset of Fine-Grained Emotions
sources.usage: Reddit comments; 27 emotions collapsed to 3-way polarity by majority rater label.

sources.name: TweetEval sentiment
sources.citation: Barbieri et al. (2020), TweetEval: Unified Benchmark and Comparative Evaluation for Tweet Classification
sources.usage: Held-out 3-class benchmark for model comparison (not loaded into the dashboard).

notes: Dates come from the source records; Sentiment140 is 2009-2010 and GoEmotions is 2019.
Topic tags are rule-based (research/data.py) and documented in docs/RESEARCH.md.
Gold labels are retained for evaluation only; the dashboard shows model predictions.
No tweets are redistributed; the downloader fetches public research datasets.
